Pokémon Adventures RGB volume 2 (Japanese: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL pbk-edition 赤緑青編 2 Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter volume 2) is the second volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.

==Major events==
meets .

==Party changes==

's "Ratty" in PS036.

===Evolutions===
's evolves into sometime between PS018 and PS027.
